# Quaternius "Farm Animals Animated": Horse

`Horse.blend` is the horse from Quaternius' **Farm Animals Animated** pack, copied unchanged. It is the source of the horse in
`apps/web/public/game-modes/at-yarisi/models/horse.glb` (built by `assets/game-modes/at-yarisi/scripts/build_horse.py`, which keeps the
horse's mesh and its Run, Idle, Walk and Jump animations and adds our own jockey).

  released under CC0 on their site and on itch.io. This pack's zip contained no licence file of its own (the author's Stylized Nature

- Downloaded 2026-11-23 by the product owner from the author's page; not modified.
